To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Elementary school teachers' perception of principal instructional leadership is related to teachers' science teaching efficacy; 2) Teachers' science teaching efficacy is a significant factor related to their science teaching practice; 3) Teachers who perceive their principals as providing instructional leadership in the areas of curriculum, instruction and evaluation, have significantly higher science teaching efficacy; and, 4) Teachers' science efficacy is a stronger predictor of their science teaching practice than their perceptions of the principal's instructional leadership.
